{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_parsed'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99]

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']

# Filter for completed orders AND remove QA orders
completed_cleaned = sales[
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders (cleaned)
mean_revenue = completed_cleaned['revenue_parsed'].mean()

# Verify the final population
n_completed_cleaned = len(completed_cleaned)

print(f"Number of completed orders after removing QA: {n_completed_cleaned}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.6f}")"}
